original_target.title: Lawson surfaces as Willmore minimizers in every higher genus

scope_comparison: Theorem1.1 and section4 prove a Willmore lower bound and Mobius equality classification only under the specified halfturn-group symmetry. No unrestricted all-genus lower bound and equality classification was located. Mobius bands, Klein bottles, higher codimension and fixed conformal classes have different scopes.
